import numpy as np

def softmax(z, axis=-1):
    e = np.exp(z - z.max(axis=axis, keepdims=True))
    return e / e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True)

def attention(Q, K, V):
    d = Q.shape[-1]
    scores = Q @ K.T / np.sqrt(d)             # độ tương hợp truy vấn-khoá
    weights = softmax(scores, axis=-1)        # mỗi hàng là phân phối, tổng = 1
    return weights @ V, weights               # trung bình có trọng số của V

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
Q = rng.normal(size=(3, 4)); K = rng.normal(size=(3, 4)); V = rng.normal(size=(3, 2))
out, w = attention(Q, K, V)
print(out.shape, w.sum(axis=1).round(3))

def positional_encoding(n, d):
    pos = np.arange(n)[:, None]
    i = np.arange(d)[None, :]
    angle = pos / np.power(10000, (2 * (i // 2)) / d)
    pe = np.zeros((n, d))
    pe[:, 0::2] = np.sin(angle[:, 0::2])
    pe[:, 1::2] = np.cos(angle[:, 1::2])
    return pe
print(positional_encoding(4, 6).round(3)[1])

import numpy as np

def softmax(z, axis=-1):
    e = np.exp(z - z.max(axis=axis, keepdims=True))
    return e / e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True)

def attention(Q, K, V):
    d = Q.shape[-1]
    weights = softmax(Q @ K.T / np.sqrt(d), axis=-1)
    return weights @ V, weights

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
Q = rng.normal(size=(3, 4)); K = rng.normal(size=(3, 4)); V = rng.normal(size=(3, 2))
out, weights = attention(Q, K, V)
print(out.shape)
